name: diffmode-growth-tactics
description: Diffmode's free growth-ideation pipeline as a Claude Code plugin. A /run-growth-tactics orchestrator drives the full DAG — fast diagnostics intake (URL research or minimal Q&A) -> 2-wave enrichment -> parallel think-tank research (competitor-gaps, cross-industry, platform-arbitrage), with per-run growth-factors mining (a clean-room LIGHT vector DB built fresh from public case studies) running concurrently from right after the competitors gate -> lite synthesis constraints -> a 2-stage synthesis: explore (blind vector combinations + emergent mechanisms) -> build (white-space ideation + founder-fit merge) -> a final synthesis.md of 7-9 novel demand-gen tactic IDEAS. It STOPS at synthesis: prioritization, implementation guides, and the proprietary 576-vector database stay paid. A parameterized reviewer gates two stages (enrichment competitors + the final synthesis build), score >= 7, max 3 retries; other generating stages get a structural check. Research stages use a Perplexity MCP server when present and fall back to the built-in WebSearch otherwise (fallback citations are auto-verified for reachability); analysis + synthesis stages run with no MCP by design. The run ends with a styled HTML report (WS/report/index.html, stdlib-rendered, opens in the browser) instead of bare markdown files.
